text:
clara: merged the opt-tooling PR, but spotted a bad anchor in the batch+cache example (the kv-prefetch link points to an old path). sorry for the late catch.
miguel: thanks for the catch, can you paste the exact URL? I can open a tiny follow-up PR.
clara: link is /docs/optimize/toolkit/kv-prefetch.md#prefetch-config -> 404. should be /docs/optimize/toolkit/cache-prefetch.md#config
sara: ack. while you're at it, can we also standardize the snippet across py/go? I found the python example uses old client.v1 API.
rahul: pinging @miguel and @sara — I can patch the Go snippet after the link fix. small checklist: fix anchor, update py snippet to client.generate(...), run docs-lint, update crossrefs.
docs-ci: build passed for main, but linkcheck reported 2 broken anchors: /docs/optimize/toolkit/kv-prefetch.md#prefetch-config and /docs/optimize/toolkit/quant-profiles.md#short-seqs
miguel: ok I'll open PR to change the anchor and replace the python snippet. will include a tiny redirect in yaml so older links keep working.
clara: thanks. for the python change, please use the new streaming example pattern and keep batching params explicit. something like:
```
resp = client.generate(model="redwood-opt-3", input=prompt, batch_size=8, cache_policy="kv_prefetch")
for chunk in resp.stream():
  print(chunk.token, end="")
```
miguel: looks good. sara can you share the Go variant when ready so I can mirror it in the docs?
sara: here's the Go sketch (WIP):
```
resp, _ := client.Generate(ctx, api.GenerateRequest{
  Model: "redwood-opt-3",
  Input: prompt,
  BatchSize: 8,
  CachePolicy: "kv_prefetch",
})
io.Copy(os.Stdout, resp.Stream)
```
sara: note: Go client uses BatchSize int32 now after the v2 rename, will adjust in final.
rahul: I'll add a small note in the quant-profiles page about short-seq fallback; CI flagged that anchor too. propose: add "short_sequence_handling" subsection and crosslink to examples.
miguel: PR opened: #4567 — fixes anchor, updates python snippet to client.generate, adds redirect, and updates link refs. requesting review from @sara @rahul.
clara: quick review done, left minor wording nit about 'cache_policy' default. overall LG.
docs-ci: linkcheck rerun: 0 broken links, docs-lint: 1 warning (line-length in snippet). build succeeded.
rahul: merged and backported to stable branch. I also created a tiny note under quant-profiles about tradeoffs for short sequences.
sara: pushed final Go snippet update and small comment about BatchSize type.
clara: thanks all. can we add a short follow-up task to i18n channel to translate the new subsection? want to avoid delayed gaps.
miguel: good call — I'll post a request to #i18n after the backport completes.
clara: marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
